title: Passover: a Celebration of Deliverance From Oppression

sense.text: Many times we get emails asking why the Passover dates are different amongst the Israelite camps. Here’s the main reason why many camps have different Passover dates than us: “He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.”

“From the moon is the sign of feasts”: see that, the feasts are set by the moon. Then “a light that decreaseth in her perfection”. A light: that’s the key term. The moon is a light that decreases from her perfection.

“The month is called after her name”: that’s where the word month comes from; month means moon. “Increasing wonderfully in her changing, being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven”.

When you look at the moon phases, the new moon is what society calls the full moon. It decreases wonderfully in her changing till it’s dark, then it increases in her changing, which goes back to the full.

precepts.why:
“And God said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years”. Notice it keeps saying lights, lights: “let them be for lights in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth: and it was so.”

“And God made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day”: that’s the sun. “The lesser light to rule the night”: that’s the moon. This is why Israelites have different dates on the high holidays: they have yet to understand that when God made two great lights, that was the sun and what the world calls the full moon. Two great lights means exactly what it says. It doesn’t mean when it’s dark the moon was out; it doesn’t mean a quarter moon, a half moon, a sliver of a moon. It means the moon at full capacity, in its perfection: the light that decreaseth in her perfection.

“He made the stars also. And God set them in the firmament of the heaven to give light upon the earth, And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and God saw that it was good. And the evening and the morning were the fourth day.” You got to ask some of the camps: when God created two great lights, did he make the moon black? It doesn’t make any sense. We were all under that understanding at one time, when we came into the truth, but the Lord has henceforth opened our eyes to what the scriptures are saying.

sense.text:
“I will liken my judgment unto a ring: like as there is no slackness of the last, even so there is no swiftness of the first.” God’s judgment is like a ring: it goes round and round and round, and it doesn’t stop until Christ returns.

What happened during the time of the Assyrian captivity, you’re going to see it happen during the time of the Babylonian captivity, the Persian captivity, the Greek captivity, the Roman captivity, Spanish, French, Europe, America: the same judgments upon the Israelites over and over and over again.

precepts.why:
The precept to the ring. “And they shall be upon thee for a sign”: what’s going to be upon us for a sign? The curses: the curses of our oppression, the curses of our captivity. They would be upon the Israelites for a sign, a sign that proves we are the real Jews, the real Israelites.

“For a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever”: for ever means a long, long time. The transatlantic slave trade started in 1441, and we’ve been in captivity from that time till now: over 400 years. That is the ring of judgment going round, the same curses upon the same people.

sense.text:
These are key points to keep in mind as we read through today’s class. “That he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom”: we all want to know the secrets of wisdom, brothers and sisters. We all ask the Lord, give us the secrets of wisdom; Lord, open our eyes that we may have sight beyond sight, see things that no other being on earth can see.

“That they are double to that which is”: the things of God, his wisdom, is double to that which is, meaning double to that which is written.

precepts.why:
“Now we have received, not the spirit of the world”. The spirit of the world bathes in sin. The spirit of the world says, go to the people that oppressed your ancestors to learn about God, go to their schools to learn about love and justice. You mean I got to go to the oppressor that raped and robbed my ancestors, and they’re going to teach me about God? No. “But the spirit which is of God”: that’s the Holy Ghost, “that we might know the things that are freely given to us of God.”

“Which things also we speak, not in the words which man’s wisdom teacheth”: we don’t speak the words man’s wisdom teaches, because man’s wisdom teaches lie upon lie upon lie. We’re on the bottom of society, but they say we’re all equal: meanwhile white society is at the top, black and brown people on the bottom, and they say we’re all equal. That’s a lie. They say Jesus is white; show me that in the Bible. It ain’t in there; you just believe it because they said so.

“But which the Holy Ghost teacheth”: we teach according to the Holy Ghost, “comparing spiritual things with spiritual.” We compare spiritual things from Genesis to Revelation; that’s what it means. We can see now that the things that happened in ancient Egypt are happening now in this spiritual Egypt called America. We can see the things of ancient Sodom and Gomorrah taking place now here in spiritual Sodom, the United States of America. We can see things that occurred in ancient Assyria, and things that happened during the Greco-Roman Empire, happening now in the United States of America.

“But the natural man receiveth not the things of the Spirit of God”. The natural man is the sinful man, the carnal man: the man and or woman that loves oppression, that celebrates the Fourth of July, that celebrates Easter, that celebrates Christmas, that celebrates lies. That’s the natural man; that’s the natural woman. “For they are foolishness unto him”: the spiritual things of God are foolishness to him or her. “Neither can he know them, because they are spiritually discerned.”

sense.text:
We may ask the Lord, Lord, slavery is over, but we’re still being oppressed. The answer for our oppression is soon about to be obvious. “He delivereth the poor in his affliction”.

“And openeth their ears in oppression.” Can you imagine if every last one of us was financially well off: would half of us even be sitting in here? No. We’d be going, what time is Easter, when is Christmas, here comes Santa Claus, going down Santa Claus Lane. We’d be on our yachts, on our cruise ships. The only time your spiritual ears can be opened is in oppression: once you can see, feel, hear, understand, you can taste oppression. Now the ears are open; they can hear what the spiritual things of God are saying.

Just as we were oppressed under ancient Egypt and delivered, it is very similar with the deliverance soon to come.

“And their dead bodies shall lie in the street of the great city”: the dead bodies of the Israelites. The dead bodies are the spiritually dead Israelites; that’s us.

The great city, write this down, is Babylon the great, the United States of America. There is no greater system, no greater country right now; don’t get it twisted. Why is it great? Because it has the greatest system established right now, the greatest military. But in this great city we are spiritually dead: our dead bodies are here, our dead spirits are here, our dead souls are here.

“Which spiritually is called Sodom”: we know this place ain’t the real Sodom, but like we read in Corinthians, we compare spiritual things with spiritual. So if Babylon that great city is spiritually called Sodom, we got to read what happened in ancient Sodom, where they exalted same-sex marriage, incest, pedophilia, bestiality and rape, and we can see it now. We see drag queens reading for our children in the school system. We see our women patterning themselves after drag queens and thinking that’s the standard for beauty, with those stupid gigantic eyelashes, those stupid wigs that reach the ceiling and drag the floor, those BBLs, and claws for fingernails. No, sister, that comes from ancient Sodom, ancient Gomorrah; you just fell into it. They took the rainbow from the Bible and made it into an abomination: the rainbow is no longer the covenant between God and man that he would not flood the earth, they say now it’s a sign of same-sex marriage.

“And Egypt”: we know this ain’t the real Egypt either, but it says spiritually called Egypt. So we compare spiritual things with spiritual, like Paul said, meaning precept upon precept, here a little: what did God say about ancient Egypt in the Old Testament? Now we can compare those same precepts with what’s here in America, Babylon the great.

“Where also our Lord was crucified”: our Lord was crucified in Jerusalem. We know this ain’t Jerusalem, but this is a spiritual Jerusalem. We can read throughout the four Gospels where our people turned Christ over to Rome, and they destroyed not only his body but his image and his teachings. We can see they did that same thing here, comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

“And they of the people and kindreds and tongues and nations shall see their dead bodies three days and an half”: three days and a half is 350 years. “And shall not suffer their dead bodies to be put in graves”, because we’re not physically dead; we’re only spiritually dead.

“And they that dwell upon the earth shall rejoice over them, and make merry”: they’re rejoicing over our dead bodies, our destruction. Make merry means Merry Christmas; that’s the spirituality behind that festivity. It’s the celebration of the destruction of the Israelites; that’s what Merry Christmas is all about, that’s what Santa Claus is all about. The elves: we are those elves. Comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

“And shall send gifts one to another”: we were the gifts. Our sons, our daughters, our mothers, our fathers were the gifts given to the Dutch, the Spanish, the French, the Portuguese, the Americans, the English; we were those gifts given one to another.

“Because these two prophets tormented them that dwelt on the earth”: these two prophets are Judah and Israel. We tormented them with the word of God.

“And after three days and an half”, 350 years, “the Spirit of life from God entered into them”: that’s that Holy Ghost, that Comforter Christ spoke about, giving us understanding of God’s truth, his laws. Now the spirit of the Lord is entering into us; now we are waking up to the truth. We’re the twelve tribes of Israel.

“And they stood upon their feet”: we’re standing now. “And great fear fell upon them which saw them”: now that we’re standing up as the twelve tribes of Israel, great fear is falling upon the other nations. It’s falling upon five dollar Indians, upon Dawes Act Indians.

That fear includes hatred; that fear translates to hatred, lies, slander: let’s lie on them, let’s bear false witness against them, let’s get them hurt, let’s get them imprisoned, let’s threaten them. They are afraid of our freedom. When all else fails, they tell lies: it’s the same thing they did with Christ when they couldn’t combat his influence and the way the people were gravitating to him. Christ said we’re going to drink of the same cup; that’s why every time people attack us, it’s with lies. All you got to do when people make up lies is ask for the who, what, where, when and why, and it will unravel.

precepts.why:
The dead bodies in that great city are the dead Israelites, and Baruch names them: “O Lord Almighty, thou God of Israel, hear now the prayers of the dead Israelites”. Why are we dead? Because we wandered out of the way of understanding; because we’re oppressed; because we are in captivity.

These are our graves, whether your grave is entitled Pentecostal, Kemet, Christian, Catholic, Rastafarian: those are grave sites, and the educational system is the gravestones. Now we want to come out of those graveyards.

When God calls this place that great city, y’all know what I’m talking about: “And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city”. God says this place is called that great city, Babylon the great, the United States of America, the same great city where the dead bodies lie in Revelation 11.

sense.text:
Why are we at this particular chapter, talking about Egypt? We just read that this place is spiritually called Egypt, that we must compare spiritual things with spiritual, and that God’s judgments are like a ring: they go round and round. This was the onslaught of ancient Assyria, and our people went to Egypt for help; that’s the technical basis of it. But as you sit back and look, the same things that happened back then are applying now.

“Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help”: our people love Babylon the great, spiritually called Egypt. Woe means destruction through sorrow to them that go down to Egypt for help: help me America, help me Babylon. “And stay on horses, and trust in chariots”: our people trust in the military, they trust in the system. “But they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!” Our people have filled the churches, but they don’t look to the Holy One of Israel. They look to the president, to the United States government, to the military.

“Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words”: God is not going to call back his words. “But will arise against the house of the evildoers”: just as he rose up against ancient Assyria and ancient Egypt, he’s going to rise against Babylon the great, the United States of America.

“And against the help of them that work iniquity”: our people work iniquity, and our sinful, iniquity-keeping people want the help of America: help us keep Easter, help us keep Kwanzaa, help us keep Christmas, help us be assimilated into society.

“Now the Egyptians are men, and not God”: America is men, they are not God. Remember, this place is spiritually called Egypt. Why does it say that? Because just as it was back then, so is it today: our people saw the Egyptians as gods, and they see no fault in this white man, just as we thought there was no fault in the ancient Egyptians.

“And their horses flesh, and not spirit”: God’s horses, his chariots, are spirit, God’s angels. America’s horses and chariots are made out of things from the earth, steel, iron, fiberglass, things you can touch. God’s chariots you’re not shooting down; they’re not running out of gas; a gamma bomb won’t affect them.

“When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall”: anybody that helps Egypt, Babylon. “And he that is holpen shall fall down”: anybody that is helped by Egypt, you’re going to fall down too. “And they all shall fail together”: both the helper and the holpen, America and her citizens, shall fall. That’s what the Bible prophesies.

“Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice”: the Lord will not be afraid of America’s voice, their military, their Space Force. The Lord fears no man, nothing. “Nor abase himself for the noise of them”: he’s not going to abase himself to Space Force, the United States government. “So shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.”

“As birds flying”: this is a military strategy, a military formation. Look at how you got the leader of the birds in the front: that represents Christ, the very first one. Then you got wings that flank to the left and wings that flank to the right, that V formation. That’s a military formation; that’s where America gets it from, and that’s what the Lord put in the birds.

“So will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem”: when the Lord returns he’s going to come in that symbol, in that sign, as birds flying. “Defending also he will deliver it”: he will deliver us. “And passing over he will preserve it”: and passing over he will preserve us. They can make mockery all they want; it is going to happen.

“Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.” Listen good to that. Our ancestors back then, and some of our kin now, have revolted against the Lord of hosts: against God’s laws, his statutes, his commandments. So in this generation, our generation, the Lord says you all better turn unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.

“For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold”: we have cast away our idols of silver and our idols of gold, “which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.”

“Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword”: just as God compares America with Egypt, he compares America with Assyria; he compares the Europeans, the Caucasians, with Assyria. “Not of a mighty man”: this place won’t fall by a mighty man, “and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited”: all America’s military shall be discomfited by the Lord’s military.

“And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear”: America is going to run back to their strongholds. They got over 300 strongholds worldwide, and they’re going to pass over to their strongholds for fear. “And his princes shall be afraid of the ensign”: the military leaders of America shall fear when Christ returns; Space Force shall fear when the Son of God comes. “Saith the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.”

precepts.why:
The precept for the ensign. Isaiah explained the ensign in verse 5, as birds flying, but Isaiah 11 makes it more crystal clear. “And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse”: the root of Jesse is Jesus the Christ, “which shall stand for an ensign”. Ensign means symbol: “an ensign of the people”. Christ is that ensign of the people. Right now we have his word, his Bible, but soon to come he’s coming as God; soon to come he’s coming as birds flying.

“To it shall the Gentiles seek”: those Gentiles that seek unto the Lord are us. We are the Gentiles because we were raised as Gentiles: African-Americans, Puerto Ricans, Jamaicans, Haitians, Brazilians, Suriname, Belize, Panamanians, Mexicans. Those are Gentile names, Gentile nationalities; we are those Gentiles, and now we’re seeking to the Lord, to the God of Israel. “And his rest shall be glorious”: God’s rest shall be glorious.

So when Isaiah 31 says his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, it is Christ returning as birds flying that they shall fear.

Go back to Isaiah 11 and 10 one more time; there was some good stuff in there. Newly appointed soldiers, here’s an easy precept to go to on the street, a good precept to explain who the Gentiles are that receive salvation: “to it shall the Gentiles seek”.

“And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria”: write this down, Assyria is Turkey. “And from Egypt”: that’s Lower Egypt. “And from Pathros”: that’s Upper Egypt, that’s the Sudan. “And from Cush”: that’s Ethiopia. “And from Elam”: that’s Iran and India. “And from Shinar”: that’s Iraq. “And from Hamath”: that’s Syria. “And from the islands of the sea”: that’s the Caribbean, Cape Verde, Hawaiian, Philippines. Look them up when you get a chance: Afro-Turkey, Afro-Iranians, Afro-Iraqis. Our people are there.

“And he shall set up an ensign for the nations”: the ensign for the nations is Christ, but we know Christ ain’t here yet, so until then we have his word. This is the word of God; this is the ensign we hold. “And shall assemble the outcasts of Israel”: the Gentiles the Bible speaks of are the outcasts of Israel. “And gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth”: so the Gentiles we read about are the dispersed of Judah.

Often you hear or read about Christian commentaries that reference Isaiah prophesying, and their commentaries are stuck in time, as if what happened when Assyria came ended there, as if those curses stopped. They didn’t stop. “And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” See that part right there: upon thy seed for ever. So what happened in ancient Egypt happened in Assyria; what happened in Assyria happened in Babylon; what happened in Babylon happened in Persia and Media; what happened in Persia and Media happened in the Greek captivity; what happened in the Greek captivity happened in the Roman captivity; what happened in the Roman captivity happened in the Spanish captivity, French captivity, European captivity, American captivity. It happened over and over and over.

God’s judgment is like a ring: it doesn’t slack and it doesn’t rush. It has its cycle; it must be finished, it must be fulfilled. “These are the words which I spake unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled”: all things must be fulfilled, “which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me.”
“For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.”

sense.text:
Before going to Isaiah 19, remember what we read: this place is spiritually called Egypt.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger”: we’re going to serve enemies for food, “and in thirst” for water, “and in nakedness” for clothing, “and in want of all things”: anything that we want, we must serve for it. “And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.”

Just as it happened in ancient Egypt, it happened in Assyria, it happened in Babylon, it happened in Persia and Media, it happened in Greece, it happened in Rome. Now we’re speeding up to America today: these curses are upon us.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again”: this ain’t the real Egypt it’s talking about, it’s a spiritual Egypt. “With ships”: these are photos of real slave ships, slaves on real slave ships. This is what the Bible prophesies about, and they want to call it hate speech. Why is it called hate? Because it’s the truth.

“By the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again”: we would go into spiritual Egypt with ships. “And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies”: once we got off those ships, we would be sold unto our enemies, “for bondmen”, slave men. And not only us: there are drawings from Wall Street of American Indians being sold as slaves, the black woman sitting down holding her baby next to the American Indian woman hugging her young child who’s being sold into slavery. Is that hate speech? We’re just telling the truth.

“For bondmen and bondwomen”: that’s what happened to the Native American Indian woman, the Native American Indian man and their children; the black man, woman and child; the indigenous women, men and children. The American Indians were sold on Wall Street just as the black man and the black woman were sold on Wall Street. We were the first commodities. We were the ones that started the economics of this system that got them financially wealthy: them selling our fathers, our mothers, our sons, our daughters as slaves. This is what happened to us, the painful history nobody wants to talk about.

“And no man shall buy you”: that means no man shall save you, no man shall redeem you; no one shall save you from captivity. Look at AIM, the American Indian Movement: men that rose up during the 60s and tried to overcome white supremacy. Leonard Peltier was one of the head guys. They rose up because of the Black Panthers, because of people like Malcolm X and Martin Luther King. Judah inspires; Judah is the fire that ignites the tribes. They had the American flag upside down, talking about oppression: men standing up against oppression. They got sparked to revolt because of Judah, the American black.

And everybody that rose up ended up like this, in the stocks. This is what happened to the American Indian and the Mexicans in captivity: anybody that rose up against America, that’s what they did to our people. No man shall buy you.

The woman in the article said nobody listens to American Indians. God only listens to you when you speak right. You speak against your brothers Judah, the Lord ain’t hearing you, and he’s going to make sure your oppressor don’t hear you either.

These are the sons and daughters of Israel God is looking for today: the ones that stand up for revolution, the ones that stand up for truth and justice, not no beaten-down, trodden, oppressed and depressed American Indian or negro. The Young Lords, the Puerto Rican movement that was sparked by Judah during the 60s; the Brown Berets, the so-called Mexicans that rose up in revolution; the Black Panthers that rose up during the 60s: these are the men and women the Lord is looking for.

When you read Christian commentaries, they say Isaiah is prophesying about Assyria coming against Egypt. But look at verse 1: “The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud”. Does it say Assyria riding upon a swift cloud? No. The Lord rideth upon his swift cloud, meaning a swift chariot. That’s the same thing we read a little while ago in Isaiah 31.

“And shall come into Egypt”: what Egypt? Spiritual Egypt, the United States of America, Babylon the great. This ain’t the real Egypt; this is spiritually called Egypt.

“And the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence”: moved at his presence means destroyed when he comes. The Washington Monument is an idol of Egypt; they brought those same idols here. White Jesus. Grand Central Station, where they got Hermes and the Cupids all around. Abraham Lincoln on his throne: they talk about Abraham Lincoln freed the slaves. No, God freed the slaves. And that famous one in Brazil that our people bow down and worship too: all the world comes to bow, worship and kiss this idol, this damnable abominable idol that God hates.

“And the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.”

“And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians”: this is why it’s called spiritual Egypt. The white man knows this ain’t the real Egypt, but the white scholars know this place is spiritual Egypt. That’s why they got an Egyptian pyramid, that All-Seeing Eye, on your dollar bill; they said only the smart of them, the spiritual ones, will figure this out.

He’s going to set white folks against white folks, the Democrats against the Republicans, the conservatives against the liberals. He’s going to make them go to war with each other. Civil war: it happened on January 6, and don’t think it’s over. It ain’t over; the party ain’t over. We just got to sit back and watch the prophecies unfold.

“And they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom”: it’s going to escalate to kingdom against kingdom.

“And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof”: that spirit of Egypt, that mighty spirit of oppression, shall fail in the midst thereof.

“And I will destroy the counsel thereof”: their counsel. The White House chief of staff is usually the most trusted advisor of the president. The Joint Chiefs of Staff are the president’s advisors when it comes to war. The cabinet is an advisory body made up of the heads of the fifteen executive departments, the president’s closest confidants. When a president is discussing war or things of that nature, these are his advisors.

“And they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers”: their charmers are the people the president sits down with. “And to them that have familiar spirits”: those are the Joint Chiefs of Staff, their cabinet; the Bible’s just using different words. “And to the wizards”: the people that work with the scientists that create weapons of war, weapons of mass destruction, conventional weapons the like of which we have never seen. Don’t think it’s talking about a voodoo man running through the White House. It’s talking about technological advancements, men and women immense in science, science strategists in war.

“And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord”: back then you had Sargon of Assyria that came over, and after him you had Nebuchadnezzar. In America, no matter what, every four years you get a new president. “And a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts”: the Lord is prophesying we’re going to have kings of fierceness that rule over us.

“And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.” From the rivers turned far away and “the brooks of defence” emptied and dried up, to the paper reeds withering, the fishers mourning, “they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish”, and they that “weave networks, shall be confounded”: this is talking about the economy falling, the economy falling in Egypt, Babylon the great.

“Surely the princes of Zoan are fools”: Zoan was of Egypt. Those princes are the same ones in verse 3, the charmers, them that have familiar spirits, and the wizards. “The counsel of the wise counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish”: become stupid. Now we know who those princes and wise counsellors are: the president’s cabinet, the Joint Chiefs of Staff, the people he sits down with to be advised on what to do and what not to do.

“How say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?” How can you come to the president and say, I’m the son of wise men of ancient times, my bloodline goes way back? The Lord don’t give a damn about that.

“Where are they? where are thy wise men?” God is asking a question: where are your counselors, where’s your cabinet, where’s your Joint Chiefs of Staff? Because the Lord shall come into Egypt like we read in verse 1. “And let them know what the Lord of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt”: they don’t know what the Lord purposed upon Egypt. We know: Isaiah told you in verse 1, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, the idols of Egypt moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt melting.

Ask these Christian pastors what the Lord of hosts has purposed against America, against France, against Syria, against Turkey, against Egypt. They don’t know, they don’t care, and they’re going to be destroyed right along with them.

“The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof. The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof”: that perverse spirit is a spirit of confusion and homosexuality, that spirit of perversion that’s mixed here, that the Lord has allowed. “And they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.”

“Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.” Verse 15 explains what we read from verse 5 to 9: the economy falling, things languishing, no work around. This is why we tell you men and women: prepare, prepare, prepare.

“In that day shall Egypt be like unto women”: Egypt, which is America, shall be like women, a spirit of fear. Don’t look to women for bravery and courage of war; they don’t have that spirit. You see that spirit now in the school system, in Generation Z, generation zombie: emotional men. “And it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shaketh over it”: the Lord’s judgment is coming, the Lord’s judgment is here. Day after day, week after week, month after month, year after year, we see what’s happening.

“And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself”: that’s referring to the prophets. Christian commentaries explain that Assyria would come through the land of Judah into Egypt, that’s how they would attack Egypt, through Israel; be aware of that in case you read it. But looking at it with spiritual eyes, this is the prophets standing up.

Here’s the proof: “because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts, which he hath determined against it.” What is the counsel of the Lord of hosts? The Bible.

“In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan”: the language of Canaan goes back to the bottom of verse 17, “the counsel of the Lord of hosts.” The language of Canaan is the counsel of the Lord of hosts: speaking the words of God. The commentaries say that’s Hebrew; it’s not talking about that.

Five don’t mean five; it’s just a certain number. For example: America, men and women here speaking the counsel of the Lord of hosts; Canada, another great country, speaking the counsel of the Lord of hosts; our brothers in Europe; men over in Africa; our brothers in the Caribbean, all speaking the language of Canaan, the counsel of the Lord of hosts.

“And swear to the Lord of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.” Guess which city is going to be destroyed: America, Babylon the great. One of those cities, which is Babylon, shall be called the city of destruction: that’s this place here.

“In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt”: guess what, you men, you officers, you captains, deacons, Bishops, you are that altar. “And a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord”: we’re the pillar. A pillar is a leader, something that holds the house up, holds the house of Israel together. That’s us here in Egypt.

“And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors”: that’s us here, crying to the Lord because of the oppressors. That’s Joel 2:17.

“And he shall send them a saviour”: he’s going to send Christ, the Son of God, King of kings and Lord of lords, “and a great one, and he shall deliver them”: he’s going to deliver us.

“And the Lord shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the Lord, and perform it. And the Lord shall smite Egypt”: he’s going to destroy Egypt. “He shall smite and heal it”: the healing is not talking about healing America. That healing of Egypt is the Israelites who thought they were Egyptian, who thought they were American, who thought they were African-American, like we read earlier in Isaiah 11:11. “And they shall return even to the Lord, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.”

“In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria”: this is talking about the Israelites in the lands of their captivity; that’s all it’s talking about. “In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land: Whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.”

precepts.why:
They talk about Abraham Lincoln freed the slaves. No, God freed the slaves. “If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say”: he repeated it in case you’re slow of learning, “If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us”: when the white man rose up against us, “Then they had swallowed us up quick.”

Stop giving the white man credit for things the Lord allowed to happen. The white man hates our guts. Who do you think those men were that rose up? That was the white man. This is what happened to us.

This explains the city of destruction. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. God is calling Edom the daughter of Babylon; that’s another term for America here. The daughter of Babylon who art to be destroyed is the city of destruction.

More on the city of destruction. “Though Babylon should mount up to heaven”: though Babylon, the United States of America, should mount up to heaven, “and though she should fortify the height of her strength, yet from me shall spoilers come unto her, saith the Lord. A sound of a cry cometh from Babylon, and great destruction from the land of the Chaldeans”.

“Because the Lord hath spoiled Babylon, and destroyed out of her the great voice”: the great voice is their media, their democracy, their Christianity that they push worldwide, their lies that they push worldwide. “When her waves do roar like great waters, a noise of their voice is uttered: Because the spoiler is come upon her, even upon Babylon, and her mighty men are taken, every one of their bows is broken: for the Lord God of recompences shall surely requite.” Destruction, destruction: this is the city of destruction.

What are we going to cry? “Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord”: that’s the same thing as the altar and the pillar of Isaiah 19:19, “weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord”. Why? Because we’re going to be catching hell here real soon. “And give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?”

So when Isaiah 19:20 says “for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors”, that’s Joel 2:17.

sense.text:
Joel 2:17 is the precept for Isaiah 19:20, where they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors. That is us, here in Egypt, crying to the Lord because of the oppressor. Joel shows what we are going to cry.

“Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord” is the same thing as the altar and the pillar of Isaiah 19:19: the leaders, the officers, captains, deacons and Bishops that hold the house of Israel together here in the land of Egypt. They “weep between the porch and the altar”, and they say “Spare thy people, O Lord.” Why? Because we are going to be catching hell here real soon. “And give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?”

The reason we are going to cry to the Lord is the hell that is coming on the Israelites. This is why they have a campaign calling us a hate group, racist, anti-semitic: they are turning world opinion against us, stirring up hatred against Israel. This is why Christ said we shall be hated of all nations for his name’s sake. They are inciting a mob mentality against the Israelites, writing articles saying we were flashing guns, saying we kidnapped women.

One of those articles never said us by name, but it put us under the same umbrella: a ‘radical black Israelites’, a ‘racist cult’. They always leave it very vague. It said a daughter was in an arranged marriage to a man fifteen years older than her. Do we do arranged marriages? No. We don’t force sisters to marry, and most of the time we tell you that you ain’t ready, especially if we don’t know the man. So that’s a damn lie. It said this religion believes marriage licenses and ceremonies are unnecessary. That’s how you know it ain’t us: we tell you that if you ain’t got no marriage license you are not recognized as married, and we show you the scriptures; we got videos of our ceremonies online. It said any woman who sleeps with a man becomes his wife. We teach that is whoredom, and that God will judge adulterers and whoremongers.

How come these devils didn’t say any of that when they had us in slavery? What they are claiming the Israelites do, they literally did to us, the castration and all of that, and they said nothing about it. And if it had been us, they would have put the Bishop’s face in the article even though he had nothing to do with it. When you search, who comes up? Us in purple, because we are popular. So they are building public opinion against the Israelites, not naming Israel United in Christ, but against the Israelites in general. That is the reproach, and that is why we cry, Spare thy people.

We are going to weep between the porch and the altar and say spare thy people, because we are going to catch hell. We don’t know how long it is going to be, months or years, but it is going to be some time. This is why we are trying to set things up: we need to have our own property, so no more anonymous phone calls saying there are terrorists in the building and getting us shut down. No more depending on Esau at all.

“Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people. Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen.” When the priests cry spare thy people, the Lord answers: he pities his people and takes the reproach off them.

“But I will remove far off from you the northern army.” The Lord is going to move the military off from us, because the military is going to be one of the instruments used against the Israelites. He is going to cause something to happen in the Middle East: he will “drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea”, that is the Dead Sea, “and his hinder part toward the utmost sea”, that is the Mediterranean Sea, “and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.”

precepts.why:
Here is the precept of what is going to happen, and why we are going to cry to the Lord to spare the people of Israel: “For there shall be in every place, and in the next cities, a great insurrection upon those that fear the Lord.” There is going to be a great insurrection against those that love the Lord, those that fear the Lord. The Bible prophesies it, and it is going to happen.

“They shall be like mad men, sparing none, but still spoiling and destroying those that fear the Lord.” These nations are going to be like mad men. They are going to attack us, they are going to hate us, still spoiling those that fear the Lord. Don’t be a fool about the prophecy.

The men initiating it are devils, demons, one of them the head of the Canary Mission, and they refuse to sit down with us publicly because they know we would destroy them in the Holy Bible: we would open this Bible and crush them like grapes. The same goes for the white woman of the SPLC: let her sit down with us and go through the scriptures, ask whatever she wants, and see who is telling the lies.

This is what the Bishop is warning about, the reproach that is coming on the heritage. “There be three things that mine heart feareth; and for the fourth I was sore afraid”, sore afraid meaning very afraid.

“The slander of a city”: have we not been slandered, have not lies been coming up about us? “The gathering together of an unruly multitude”: that other five dollar Indian is trying to do that, gathering an unruly multitude with lies. “And a false accusation”: have we not had false accusations put against us?

“All these are worse than death.” It is worse than dying, because you can’t sleep, you can’t move, you can’t think, with so many people ready to attack you at once with slander, false accusation and lies.

sense.text:
“Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O nation not desired; before the decree bring forth.” The point is we are supposed to have foresight and understand that the decree is going to come. Do you understand the seriousness of what the Lord is going to do on this earth? It says to gather yourselves together before the decree bring forth: we have to be prepared before it happens.

All the prophets had foresight. They saw what was going to happen and they prepared. Christ warned them in Luke what was going to happen; some listened and some didn’t.

“Before the day pass as the chaff, before the fierce anger of the Lord come upon you.” The fierce anger of the Lord is what is going to happen in the last days, when the enemy is rough. You had better be prepared. We have to have places of refuge where we can come together to survive what is going to happen. If you think that is not real, do it your way and see what happens.

“Seek ye the Lord, all ye meek of the earth, which have wrought his judgment.” The meek of the earth are those that humble down to the laws of God and seek his judgment: that is talking about the righteous, the godly, the ones that understand judgment is coming.

“Seek righteousness, seek meekness: it may be ye shall be hid in the day of the Lord’s anger.” That ye may be hid: that means you are preparing for it. It is beautiful to come together and have these big Passovers with all these beautiful garments on, but more importantly, when the wrath of the Lord comes upon this earth, it is good to have a place of security and safety among the believers and godly people, rather than die alone.
